issues.title: SQLite CHECK constraint subquery violation
issues.why: The DDL in 00-overview.md still contains CHECK constraints with subqueries (SELECT AppLinkTypeId FROM AppLinkType...), which SQLite explicitly forbids, despite AC-ADB-13 acknowledging this and providing a fix.
issues.fix: Replace subqueries in AppLink CHECK with hardcoded constants (1 for GitProfile, 2 for Repo) as mandated by AC-ADB-13.

issues.title: Conflicting DDL Dialects in Overview
issues.why: The overview provides both SQLite (PascalCase) and PostgreSQL (snake_case) DDLs. While AC-ADB-11 designates SQLite as primary, having both in one file without clear visual separation can confuse a mediocre coder.
issues.fix: Add a prominent warning header to the PostgreSQL section: 'REFERENCE ONLY - DO NOT IMPLEMENT'.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency/Locking Strategy
issues.why: SQLite is used for CI/CD push attribution; high-frequency pushes could lead to 'database is locked' errors without a specified busy_timeout or WAL mode instruction.
issues.fix: Add 'PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;' and 'PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;' to the initialization seed data.
